raw_text: CALL TO ACTION: All students report to Shahbagh intersection at 10 AM tomorrow. We march to Parliament demanding abolition of quota system. Bring water, masks, and phone chargers. Share this to all university groups. If internet gets cut, meet at pre-arranged point B. Coordinators from each university confirm attendance by replying to this message. This is our moment. Remember: peaceful protest only. No violence. Cameras everywhere. Document everything. #QuotaReform #StudentsAgainstDiscrimination
